title: I will not promote: Sent 500+ cold emails to Spanish notaries trying to sell my invoice-chasing agent. Zero clients. Roast me.
content:
Solo founder from Madrid here. Need a reality check because I've been staring at this too long.

The product: an agent that chases a business's unpaid invoices for them. It sends the reminders in the owner's tone, escalates anything weird to a human, shuts up
